trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including Parodia arnostiana and Thalictrum. Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents with similar content. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents, again with overlapping content. All three hops completed successfully.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents using the claim verbatim, finding key evidence that Parodia arnostiana produces yellow flowers and Thalictrum is a flowering plant genus. The summarizer correctly identified the claim as false in both summaries. The query generator produced queries for hops 2 and 3, both asking whether the plants are flowering or non-flowering. All three retrievals completed and returned relevant documents. The final output contains 24 documents as specified, with expected duplicates due to the lack of deduplication in the pipeline design. No structural failures occurred; all expected steps ran and produced valid outputs.
